ui_bugs.issue: Programmatic `page.click(force=True)` on [data-testid=prebook-modal-close] sometimes fails to close the modal in Playwright (modal stays visible). Direct DOM .click() AND a real user mouse click work fine (verified via JS-click). Likely a Playwright pointer-events / hit-testing quirk caused by the backdrop sibling; NOT a real user-facing bug. Adding `pointer-events: none` to backdrop or wrapping card with higher stacking context (e.g. z-10 on card) would harden this for tests.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add `pointer-events: none` to the backdrop div OR `z-10 relative` to the card wrapper in PrebookModal so the close button is more reliably clickable in automated tests / against tricky overlay z-stacking.
(Pre-existing minor) Move db.otp_codes attempts $inc inside the failed-verify branch of /api/prebook/verify-otp demo path.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/NavAirLanding.jsx is 1803 lines — exceeds the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into per-section components (Hero/Features/Showcase/Comparison/Pricing/AirPurificationSeries/Roadmap/About/Faq/Footer/PrebookModal) under src/pages/navair/*.

PrebookModal: backdrop div has onClick={onClose} but does not stop propagation, and card is a sibling (not child) of backdrop. This works in practice but can confuse hit-testing — consider making the card a child of a non-clickable backdrop or adding stopPropagation on the card.

rca of the issue: No critical bugs. The only flagged UI item is a Playwright/hit-test quirk on prebook-modal-close (not user-facing). Repro: open modal via pricing-cta-N, call page.click('[data-testid=prebook-modal-close]', force=True), check modal still detached — sometimes stays. Mitigation: use page.keyboard.press('Escape') or page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=prebook-modal-close]').click()"), OR fix on the app side by adding `pointer-events: none` to the backdrop div in PrebookModal (NavAirLanding.jsx L788).
